title: Grayton Beach "Birdie-A" 174 Barton's Way
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Private beach access at Sanctuary by the Sea- New furnishings- Tennis/Pickleball- 2 community Pools (One pool is heated only between the dates of 11/15-12/2, 12/16-1/6, and March spring break 3/4-5/20)- Clubhouse amenities- 6 Passenger Low-Speed Vehicle - 4 adult bikes- Office- Garage- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Surrounded by lush foliage and leafy palm trees, Birdie-A is a Grayton Beach home that sleeps 10 guests with 4 bedrooms and 4.5 bathrooms. Enjoy relaxing on the spacious porches or take advantage of the community amenities, including tennis/pickleball courts and 2 community pools.An inviting front porch with rocking chairs, perfect for slow-paced mornings, welcomes guests to this charming 2-story home. Inside, find a beautiful great room designed in a palette of sea-inspired grays and crisp whites with soaring coffered ceilings. Plush, slip-covered couches and 2 armchairs invite laid-back evenings in front of the TV after a day in the sun. The chef of the group will love cooking in the modern kitchen, featuring high-end appliances and a 4-stool breakfast bar for casual dining or entertaining. Guests can share meals at the impressive wood table with 2 long benches and 2 chairs or head out to the picnic table on the screened-in porch for alfresco dining in the coastal air. A grill for barbecuing burgers or fresh shrimp kabobs and an outdoor shower around the side of the home offer the full beach-living experience. At the end of the night, retire to the lovely guest bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom on this floor.The second level hosts additional sleeping accommodations, each with a private bathroom and Smart TV. The first guest bedroom has a king bed and access to the front balcony—enjoy a quiet morning reading on the cushioned patio seating. The second guest bedroom has a queen bed. Young guests or those who don’t mind sharing space can rest in the bunk room with 2 twin-over-twin beds. Additionally, there is a second balcony with sun loungers, a sunny office, and a laundry room.Discover luxurious accommodations and amenities at Grayton Beach’s Birdie-A. Exploring is easy with parking for 2 vehicles, 4 complimentary adult bikes, and a 6-passenger low-speed vehicle. The nearest beach access is at Sanctuary by the Sea. From the entrance of The Preserve, head east on West County Highway 30A, take the crosswalk, and the gated boardwalk will be on the left. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 10):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub SeparateSECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: 2 Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate*Guests who are 25 years of age or younger must be accompanied by a responsible parent or guardian in any vacation rental managed by Callista by 360 Blue. We do not rent homes to those 25 years of age or younger who are unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian. Moreover, there must be a ratio of at least (1) parent or guardian over the age of 25 for every four (4) young adults who are 25 years of age or younger.
